result.topic_en: Scratch calculations: a substitution transforming a second-order differential equation in log s, modular computations of the order of 2 modulo primes such as 193, 449, 577 and 769, linear relations in λ, μ, ν with constants a, b, c (ellipsoid axes), and integration of a first-order partial differential equation.
result.transcription:
$y = e^{\sigma i} z$
$\frac{\partial y}{\partial \log s} = e^{\sigma i}\frac{\partial z}{\partial \log s} + e^{\sigma i}\sigma i z$
$\frac{\partial^2 y}{\partial \log s^2} = e^{\sigma i}\frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial \log s^2} + 2e^{\sigma i}\sigma i\frac{\partial z}{\partial \log s} - e^{\sigma i}\sigma\sigma z + e^{\sigma i}\sigma i z$
$(\sigma\sigma - \nu\nu) y = e^{\sigma i}(\sigma\sigma + \nu\nu) z$
$\frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial \log s^2} + 2\sigma i\frac{\partial z}{\partial \log s} - \nu\nu z + \sigma i z = 0$

$q_1 = \varrho(v, q_2 \cdots q_n)$
